name: Smith Machine Behind The Neck Press
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Sit on an upright bench or stand inside the Smith machine, positioning yourself so the bar rests behind your head, just above shoulder height.
2. Grip and Posture: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Engage your core and maintain an upright torso.
3. Pressing Movement: Push the bar upward by fully extending your arms, keeping your head slightly forward to avoid contact.
4. Controlled Lowering: Slowly lower the bar back behind your neck until elbows form approximately a 90-degree angle, maintaining controlled tension in your shoulders.
5. Repeat: Complete the desired repetitions, typically 8–12 reps per set.
